description: Introspect ANY specific program/contract address on a chain. Solana/Slonana: returns executable, owner, data size, and whether it is a known program. EVM: RPC-verified facts (is-contract, code size, ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals, EIP-1967 proxy → implementation) PLUS Blockscout explorer enrichment when available.

address.description: Program id (base58, Solana/Slonana) or contract address (0x…, EVM)

chain.description: solana | slonana | robinhood | hyperevm | ethereum | base | stable | plasma | tempo | codex

name: describe_program

codeSize.description: EVM bytecode length in bytes. EVM only — omitted when the chain is Solana/Slonana (dataLen is the Solana equivalent)

dataLen.description: account data length in bytes. Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM (codeSize is the EVM equivalent)

erc20.description: ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals. EVM only — omitted when the address is not an ERC-20, or the chain is Solana/Slonana

executable.description: Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM

exists.description: Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM (isContract is the EVM equivalent)

isContract.description: EVM only — omitted when the chain is Solana/Slonana, where executable/isProgram carry this instead

isProgram.description: Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM

known.description: curated registry entry {id,name,type,note} when the address is recognised

lamports.description: Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM

owner.description: owning program. Solana/Slonana only — omitted when the chain is EVM

proxy.description: EIP-1967 proxy standard + implementation. EVM only — omitted when the address is not a proxy, or the chain is Solana/Slonana
